options.name: access_token
options.description: The access token used to authenticate.

options.name: encryption_spec
options.description: If set, both of the online and offline data storage will be secured by this key.

options.name: env_type
options.description: Specifies which Ansible environment you're running this module within. This should not be set unless you know what you're doing. This only alters the User Agent string for any API requests.

options.name: force_destroy
options.description: If set to true, any EntityTypes and Features for this Featurestore will also be deleted.

options.name: labels
options.description: A set of key/value label pairs to assign to this Featurestore. **Note**: This field is non-authoritative, and will only manage the labels present in your configuration.

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the Featurestore. This value may be up to 60 characters, and valid characters are [a-z0-9_]. The first character cannot be a number. This property is immutable, to change it, you must delete and recreate the resource.

options.name: online_storage_ttl_days
options.description: TTL in days for feature values that will be stored in online serving storage. The Feature Store online storage periodically removes obsolete feature values older than onlineStorageTtlDays since the feature generation time. Note that onlineStorageTtlDays should be less than or equal to offlineStorageTtlDays for each EntityType under a featurestore. If not set, default to 4000 days.

options.name: project
options.description: The Google Cloud Platform project to use.

options.name: region
options.description: The region of the dataset. eg us-central1. This property is immutable, to change it, you must delete and recreate the resource.

options.name: scopes
options.description: Array of scopes to be used.

options.name: service_account_contents
options.description: The contents of a Service Account JSON file, either in a dictionary or as a JSON string that represents it.

options.name: service_account_email
options.description: An optional service account email address if machineaccount is selected and the user does not wish to use the default email.

options.name: service_account_file
options.description: The path of a Service Account JSON file if serviceaccount is selected as type.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the resource should exist in GCP.
